name: waithowmuch
description: 14 skills for Amazon sellers: sales and revenue history, profit and landed cost, ad spend, keywords, listing and review teardowns, brand valuation, TikTok Shop and outside traffic, product finding, case studies. Use your own provider keys or one WaitHowMuch key; figures are estimates.

whm_api_key.title: WaitHowMuch API key (option B: covers every skill)
whm_api_key.description: One key for every skill. Leave empty if you use your own provider keys. Get one at https://api.waithowmuch.com/go/whm-key?from=plugin

keepa_api_key.title: Keepa API key (option A)
keepa_api_key.description: Your own paid Keepa API key; lookups spend your Keepa tokens. Used by most skills. https://keepa.com/#!api

junglescout_api_key.title: Jungle Scout API key (option A)
junglescout_api_key.description: Format "<key name>:<key>". Ad spend and organic keywords. Jungle Scout plan with the API add-on.

dataforseo_login.title: DataForSEO login (option A)
dataforseo_login.description: Your DataForSEO API login (email). Keywords, ad placements, brand search and site traffic.

dataforseo_password.title: DataForSEO API password (option A)
dataforseo_password.description: Your DataForSEO API password (not your account password).

kalodata_api_key.title: Kalodata API key (option A)
kalodata_api_key.description: TikTok Shop research. From Kalodata's Open API center.

similarweb_api_key.title: Similarweb API key (option A)
similarweb_api_key.description: Website visits and channel mix for brand-outside-traffic. A Similarweb plan with API access.

amazon_ads_client_id.title: Amazon Ads API client ID (optional)
amazon_ads_client_id.description: Your own Amazon Ads API app. Prices ad-spend clicks at Amazon's suggested bids.

amazon_ads_client_secret.title: Amazon Ads API client secret (optional)
amazon_ads_client_secret.description: Client secret of your Amazon Ads API app.

amazon_ads_refresh_token.title: Amazon Ads API refresh token (optional)
amazon_ads_refresh_token.description: Refresh token for your Amazon Ads API app.

amazon_ads_profile_id.title: Amazon Ads profile ID (optional)
amazon_ads_profile_id.description: The advertising profile to read suggested bids with.
